text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Mar-chan is tingling with joy. 
Deeply moved... totally buzzing...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... all I did was say happy birthday so 
far...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Just," is it? It certainly is "just," 
yes. However—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san remembers Mar-chan, and 
Mar-chan and Miracle-san... are right 
here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Being able to call that 'just'... makes me 
so happy after all. It's a Miracle. That's 
what Mar-chan thinks.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's... You're right. You're absolutely 
right.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm really happy too. Getting to wish you 
a happy birthday, Chan-Mi.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this year was yet another truly 
wonderful birthday, chan—well then, until 
next year.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, don't end it yet...! I even 
made sure to bring a present with me...!
